name: Turing Generator Project Scope
purpose: Defines the project scope, MVP scope and target product boundaries of the Turing Generator.

project.working_title: AI-assisted migration of heterogeneous engineering information into valid SysML v2 model structures
project.system_type: Recipe-based, artifact-driven and human-reviewed model synthesis system
project.primary_goal: Support the transformation of heterogeneous legacy engineering information into valid, reviewable and traceable SysML v2 model artifacts.

target_product_definition.description: The target product is an extensible engineering workflow system that uses persistent context artifacts, task-specific recipes, agent personalities, human review gates and SysML v2 artifact generation to support Architecture as Code.
core_capabilities: Ingest heterogeneous machine-readable legacy engineering data
Require human review before extracted content becomes approved input
Normalize approved input into a canonical internal representation
Create bounded and source-traceable information units
Select task-specific recipes, context and agent personalities
Generate candidate model data through one or more agent personalities
Compare candidate artifacts and present differences, agreement and uncertainty
Require human approval before candidate output becomes approved model data
Generate SysML v2 textual artifacts from approved model data
Preserve traceability across input, recipes, context, agent personalities, decisions and output
Prepare generated SysML v2 artifacts for validation
target_extensions: Controlled data completion for incomplete legacy data
Terminology alignment with a defined technical vocabulary
Support for multiple LLM backends or specialized agent implementations
Extended SysML v2 target notation coverage

mvp_definition.description: The MVP is a selected executable subset of the intended target architecture. It is not a throwaway prototype. It shall demonstrate the core artifact-based and human-reviewed workflow with limited scope.
mvp_definition.mvp_goal: Demonstrate that recipe-based orchestration, persistent context, persona-based candidate generation, human review gates and SysML v2 artifact generation can be combined into a traceable engineering workflow.
included_capabilities: Context files for project principles, SysML v2 target notation and project scope
Source manifest distinguishing normative references from example references
Recipe files with prompt and procedure definitions
SysML v2 text artifact generation into data/output/

limited_capabilities.mvp_limitation: The MVP supports only selected machine-readable input formats.
The MVP generates only a deliberately limited SysML v2 language subset.
The MVP may use one LLM backend with multiple personality files.
The MVP prepares files for validation but may not implement a full automated validation feedback loop.
The MVP UI may remain simple and focused on task execution, report display and review decisions.

excluded_from_mvp: Full interaction and interface consistency management
Automated modification of protected architecture model files
Direct use of unreviewed raw legacy data for model generation

main_workflow.name: Ingest raw legacy data
main_workflow.description: The system receives or registers a raw machine-readable legacy engineering artifact.

main_workflow.name: Generate ingestion artifact
main_workflow.description: The system creates a human-readable Markdown artifact from extracted legacy information.

main_workflow.name: Review ingestion artifact
main_workflow.description: The human reviews the ingestion artifact and decides whether the content can be used downstream.

main_workflow.name: Promote approved input
main_workflow.description: Only approved or modified content is promoted into data/approved_input/.

main_workflow.name: Normalize approved input
main_workflow.description: Approved input is normalized into a canonical internal representation.

main_workflow.name: Create information units
main_workflow.description: The system creates bounded and source-traceable normalized information units.

main_workflow.name: Select recipe, context and agent personalities
main_workflow.description: The orchestrator selects the task-specific recipe, required context and selected agent personalities.

main_workflow.name: Generate candidate artifacts
main_workflow.description: The task is executed using one or more selected agent personalities.

main_workflow.name: Generate comparison report
main_workflow.description: Candidate artifacts are compared and presented in a human-readable review report.

main_workflow.name: Review candidate output
main_workflow.description: The human accepts, rejects or modifies candidate output.

main_workflow.name: Promote approved model data
main_workflow.description: Only approved or modified candidate output is promoted into approved model data.

main_workflow.name: Generate SysML v2 output
main_workflow.description: The system generates SysML v2 text artifacts into data/output/.

main_workflow.name: Prepare validation
main_workflow.description: Generated SysML v2 artifacts are prepared for validation in the selected validation environment.

review_gates.name: Ingestion Review Gate
review_gates.rule: Raw extracted content must not become approved input without human review.

review_gates.name: Candidate Review Gate
review_gates.rule: Candidate output must not become approved model data without human review.

raw_legacy_data.downstream_rule: May only be used to generate ingestion artifacts.

ingestion_reports.purpose: Stores human-readable Markdown reports generated from raw legacy data.

approved_input.purpose: Stores reviewed and approved input for downstream processing.

intermediate.purpose: Stores canonical representations, information units, candidate artifacts and approved model data.

reports.purpose: Stores human-readable candidate, comparison and review reports.

output.purpose: Stores generated SysML v2 output artifacts.

traceability.purpose: Stores traceability records linking sources, recipes, context, agents, decisions and outputs.

modeling_scope.architecture_model_purpose: Contains the manually curated architecture model of the Turing Generator itself.
modeling_scope.generated_output_purpose: Contains SysML v2 files generated by the Turing Generator.
modeling_scope.protection_rule: Architecture model files may be read for context but shall not be modified unless explicitly requested.

principles: Use the orchestrator as central coordinator.
Do not hardcode prompts into Python modules.
Read prompts and procedures from recipe artifacts.
Use JSON for structured state and decisions.
Use Markdown for human-readable review artifacts.
Write generated SysML v2 files to data/output/.
implementation_scope.initial_mvp_execution_goal: Create the first executable workflow from raw input registration to ingestion artifact generation and review preparation.

success_criteria: The workspace structure is explicit and purpose-driven.
A raw legacy artifact can be registered.
A human-readable ingestion artifact can be generated.
The ingestion artifact can be reviewed by a human.
Approved content can be promoted into approved input.
Candidate artifacts can be generated using recipes, context and agent personalities.
A human-readable comparison report can be generated.
Approved model data can be transformed into SysML v2 output.
Generated SysML v2 output is stored in data/output/.
Traceability is maintained across relevant artifacts.
